principle: Metrics reward quality and novelty rates, NOT raw hypothesis count.

observational_grounding_rate.definition: Fraction of propositions passing observation_provenance minimum payload + LAUNDER tests

falsifiability_rate.definition: Fraction with complete falsifiable_expectation + null_competing_explanation + BC_Q5/Q6 pass

executability_rate.definition: Fraction with executability_status=EXECUTABLE after grammar validation

semantic_duplicate_rate.definition: Fraction collapsed as duplicates within session (similarity >= 0.90)

template_adjacent_rate.target_direction: track separately — counts toward extended creativity

propositions_per_useful_survivor.definition: total_generated / count(survivors with grounding AND falsifiability AND executability)

abandoned_hypothesis_rate.definition: Fraction reaching ABANDON or FALSIFY in lineage within session
abandoned_hypothesis_rate.target_direction: neutral — high abandon after test is healthy; high abandon pre-test may indicate spam

evidence_responsive_redirection_rate.definition: Fraction of lineage transitions triggered by experiment evidence (not fixed catalog)

hidden_convergence_class.definition: Aggregate bucket from zone D — NONE/PARTIAL/MODERATE/HIGH

scientific_novelty.question: Is the question genuinely new relative to encoded priors?

scientific_quality.question: Is it grounded, coherent, falsifiable, executable?

empirical_usefulness.question: Does evidence support it?
empirical_usefulness.note: Evaluated AFTER experiments — not at proposition birth

metrics: Incremental predictive value vs baseline — OUT OF SCOPE for BB-Prop-01 v1
market_edge.question: Actionable value?
market_edge.note: Deferred to separate benchmark; novel-but-false propositions are NOT generator failures

pathological_hypothesis_spam_run.reporting: Session excluded from primary scoreboard; flagged for architecture review

novelty_not_usefulness_rule.explicit: A scientifically novel proposition may be empirically false — that is NOT generator failure
novelty_not_usefulness_rule.generator_failure_is: Ungrounded, unfalsifiable, template-laundered, or spam-volume driven
